d:
Here is the song "Apna Har Din" from the Bollywood Blockbuster movie 'Golmaal 3' featuring Ajay Devgan, Kareena Kapoor, Arshad Warsi, Tushar Kapoor, Shreyas Talpade, Mithun Chakraborty, Kunal Khemu. The song is in the marvellous voice of Shaan and Anoushka Manchanda.
Song - Apna Har Din Aise Jiyo
Film - Golmaal 3
Music Director - Pritam
Singer - Shaan, Anouska Manchanda
Lyricist - Kumaar
Artist - Ajay Devgan, Kareena Kapoor, Arshad Warsi, Tushar Kapoor, Shreyas Talpade, Mithun Chakraborty, Kunal Khemu
Music On - T-Series
